edit.statement: The death of a pope causes his Ring of the Fisherman to be ceremonially destroyed by the camerlengo.
edit.subject: The death of a pope
edit.object: the destruction of his Ring of the Fisherman
edit.scope: Popes who die in office; the ring is smashed or defaced in front of the cardinals so it cannot seal forged documents.
